zh.title: 换一个 AI 接手，哪些东西可以带走？
zh.summary: 我们跑了四套开源实现的局部入口，再对照 CodeFlowMu 的任务、审查和授权测试。任务能交出去，随任务移动的每一种东西却需要各自的依据。

en.title: A completed task still needs separate evidence ledgers
en.summary: Specification counterexamples show why outcomes, procedure and measurement support cannot be collapsed into an unqualified success rate.
